where: BOXES mark 'selected' on rules that select an enemy unit: a|10pf8qz Soul Sight, a|13ur237 Spirit Thief, a|1tafhr4 Blood Throne, r|14qasst Cabal of Sorcerers, r|1p9ywjd Worthy Foes, r|16kt1jq Assemblage of Might (not blocking this release)
why: Kept as is for this release. My opinion, for a later branch: In all six, GW’s “select one” selects an ENEMY unit: Soul Sight “that enemy unit”, Spirit Thief “select one visible enemy VEHICLE unit”, Blood Throne and Cabal “select one enemy unit within …”, Worthy Foes “In your Command phase, select one enemy unit”, Assemblage “select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit”. The friendly units each one helps are reached by keyword (HERETIC ASTARTES, KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA, THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS, NOBLE/LYCHGUARD/TRIARCH, ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER), never selected. So the right mark is 'friendly' (shown as “From it”), not 'selected' (“Selected by it”, which says the player picked this friendly unit). The enemy selection is already its own condition: targetSelected on five, and the dreadful-foe q on Assemblage. Cabal of Sorcerers shows the slip: its first box is 'selected' and its continuation, with the same reach, is 'friendly'. The app shows the mark only for grp 'other' (another unit’s ability), so today the wrong label is visible on Spirit Thief and Blood Throne (and on Soul Sight if its empty reach puts it there). It is never visible on the army or detachment rules Cabal, Worthy Foes and Assemblage. Suggested rule: 'selected' only where the lead selects a friendly unit (“select one (other) friendly …”, as line 338 does for stratagems). Otherwise 'friendly', or 'aura' if it is one. The calculation does not change.
